clue.text: Really good drink offered with little hesitation

parts.note: to sup is to drink

explanation.surface: A fine drink is accepted after a pause.
explanation.definitionFit: Excellent; an informal word of praise.

explanation.walkthrough: 'character' means a letter of the alphabet, not a person.

explanation.walkthrough: 'may be' rearranges MERE into EMER; Ralph Waldo Emerson was the American essayist.
explanation.definitionFit: Ralph Waldo Emerson was the American essayist and poet.

clue.text: Disparage each new writer

explanation.surface: Someone belittles every newly published author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns EACH into CHEA, followed by PEN.
explanation.definitionFit: To belittle something is to make it seem of lower worth.

clue.text: Put off fellow cleaner

clue.text: Angst make many study

explanation.surface: Anxiety drives lots of people to swot.
explanation.walkthrough: In crosswords 'many' often gives a big Roman numeral such as D (500).
explanation.definitionFit: Anxiety and fear are near-synonyms for a deep foreboding.

clue.text: Quite dissimilar pairs getting involved in rendezvous

clue.text: Exercise in lounge, showing a certain circumspection

clue.text: Smooth allies-militant men at one time

clue.text: A German city magistrate

clue.text: Retire, that's the right way out
